targetAsset.description: The {@link ReliabilityAsset} to evaluate the features on.

featureNames.description: The names of the {@link Feature}s to evaluate.

title:
Allows the construction and execution of queries to get Reliability {@link Feature} data. Intended mainly for
querying `ReliabilityMlModel` features.
Only functions properly for {@link Feature}s with `subjectType` set to {@link ReliabilityAsset}.


Note that non metric backed feature evaluation does not support missing data correctly due to platform limits.
Missing data is treated as zeros. This means that aggregations can have incorrect values if missing data is
present in an aggregation period.

To avoid this, use metric backed features, which also have better performance for this function.

This query will return the data as a map of feature name to timeseries.

Usage Example:
```
ReliabilityFeatureTimedDataQuery.make({
  targetAsset: 'asset id',
  featureNames: ['feature1', 'feature2']
}).execute({
  startTime: '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z',
  endTime: '2023-01-02T00:00:00Z',
  interval: 'QUARTER_HOUR',
})
```
name: ReliabilityFeatureTimedDataQuery
